name: mystique
description: A highlighter pen for Claude's replies, and a side panel for query results as tables and for the goal, the tasks and every subagent.

highlight.title: Highlighter
highlight.description: Who marks what matters in a reply. reader: a second, small model reads each reply after the turn and marks it. claude: the replying model marks its own text as it writes (no extra call; adds a short section to the system prompt). both: the two together. bold: every bold phrase. off: only your own /highlight marks.

color.title: Pen color
color.description: The color of the highlighter pen.

reader.title: Second reader
reader.description: What the second reader is. fast: the model named below, which sees the reply, what you asked and a digest of the turn's tool calls. session: a fork of the session on its own model, which sees the whole conversation and costs a cached re-read of it.

readerModel.title: Second reader model
readerModel.description: The model the fast second reader uses: an alias (haiku) or a full model id.

capture.title: Table capture
capture.description: Which results the data panel picks up. databases: database clients and database MCP tools. everything: any table-shaped tool output. off: none.

band.title: Progress band
band.description: The band above the prompt: the goal, a task progress bar, and for the main thread and each subagent its context and its share of what the session spent.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: When the side panel opens. auto: by itself, for a query result or a new subagent. manual: only when you type /tables or /progress (a toast tells you a table was captured).
